sections.title: Connect Once, Forget It

items.title: Connect Your Channel
items.body:
One-time YouTube authorization that asks for exactly one thing: permission to add subtitles. No access to comments, analytics, or private data.

30-second signup, no credit card
Subtitle permission only

items.title: AI Transcribes & Translates
items.body:
Speech recognition tuned for Croatian, then translation to English. Your custom vocabulary keeps names, brands, and industry terms spelled right.

95%+ accuracy on clean audio
Custom dictionaries per channel

items.title: Subtitles Go Live
items.body:
Croatian and English subtitles land directly on your YouTube video. Want a final say? Turn on preview mode and approve before publishing.

Auto-published to YouTube
Optional preview before going live

sections.title: Stop Losing Your Audience
sections.lede: A typical Croatian channel misses 15-30% of its potential audience without subtitles. That's viewers watching on mute, non-native speakers, and the entire English-speaking world.

items.title: Built for the Croatian Creator Economy
items.body:
Big platforms skip small languages – YouTube's auto-captions don't support Croatian. Titlomat fills that gap with speech AI built specifically for Croatian podcasts and YouTube channels, from solo creators to podcast networks and media agencies.

Croatian-first speech recognition
English subtitles open global reach
Works for channels of any size

items.title: Mute Viewers
items.body: Most social video plays silently. Subtitles keep those viewers watching instead of scrolling past.

items.title: Search & Discovery
items.body: Subtitle text makes your videos searchable. YouTube understands what you said – and ranks you for it.

items.title: Privacy by Design
items.body: Titlomat asks only for subtitle permission. Your comments, analytics, and private data stay yours.

items.title: Accessibility
items.body: Deaf and hard-of-hearing viewers can't watch without captions. With Titlomat, every episode includes them by default.

sections.title: Start Free, Scale When Ready

closing.title: Your Next Video Deserves Subtitles
closing.body: Connect your channel in 30 seconds. Your first videos are on us – 100 free credits, no credit card.
